title: Pharmacokinetics of Oral Zoliflodacin 3 g in Healthy Lactating Women
official: An Open-label Study to Evaluate the Pharmacokinetics of a Single Oral Dose of Zoliflodacin 3 g in Milk and Plasma in Healthy Lactating Women
summary:
This is a single-arm clinical trial to evaluate the PK profile in breast milk and plasma after a single oral dose of zoliflodacin in healthy lactating women.

Eligible participants who have been actively breastfeeding or expressing milk for at least 4 weeks postpartum will receive a single dose of zoliflodacin administered as an oral suspension with food.

Breast milk and plasma samples will be collected at predefined time points for up to 48 hours after dosing to characterize zoliflodacin concentrations and estimate drug exposure in breast milk and maternal plasma. Participants will temporarily discontinue breastfeeding from study check-in until 72 hours after dosing to avoid infant exposure to zoliflodacin. Breast milk will be expressed using an electronic breast pump and collected according to the study schedule.

Participants will be admitted to the clinical research unit the day before dosing and discharged after completion of the 48-hour PK sampling period. A follow-up visit will be conducted approximately 7 days after dosing to assess safety and tolerability. A lactation consultant will be available throughout the study period and for up to 30 days after dosing, as needed.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Woman with good general health status, as determined by medical history, physical examination, laboratory tests, vital signs, and clinical judgment at Screening and check-in
* Age ≥18 to ≤45 years at the time of signing the informed consent
* Weight ≥50 kg at Screening and check-in
* Given birth to a single, healthy, clinically stable, full-term (37 to 42 weeks' gestation) infant in the past 6 weeks to 24 months before Day 1
* Agrees to not breastfeed her infant from check-in until 72 hours after zoliflodacin administration
* Has well-established lactation (ie, at least 4 weeks postpartum) and is breastfeeding her infant; supplemental infant formula use is allowable, and the extent of use of formula will be documented
* Has confirmed that her breastfed infant is able to feed from a bottle
* Agrees to collect all breast milk from predose through 2 days after the trial drug administration using an electric pump
* Has a negative pregnancy test at Screening and check-in
* Has sufficient venous access to allow for collection of plasma samples
* Agrees to use a highly effective form of contraception (see Section 5.4) with male sexual partners during the trial and for at least 28 days after the zoliflodacin dose
* Agrees to comply with all protocol requirements
* Agrees not to participate in other research trials involving investigational medication or medical devices for the duration of this trial
* Provides written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of breast implants, breast augmentation, or breast reduction surgery that, in the investigator's opinion, may have a clinical impact on breast milk expression
* Evidence of acute or chronic condition that, in the investigator's opinion, may have a clinical impact on breast milk expression
* Active mastitis within 30 days before Day 1
* Current breast abscess or cracked/bleeding nipples
* History of inadequate lactation
* Moderate or severe hepatic or renal impairment, or other clinically significant medical condition that, in the investigator's opinion, might affect zoliflodacin PK or participant safety
* Known hypersensitivity to zoliflodacin or formulation excipients
* Positive pregnancy test at Screening or check-in
* Positive NAAT result for N gonorrhoeae at Screening
* Positive serologic test for HIV-1 or HIV-2 antibody, hepatitis B surface antigen, or hepatitis C antibody at Screening. Participants whose results are compatible with prior hepatitis B vaccination (positive hepatitis B surface antibody, negative hepatitis B core antibody, and negative hepatitis B surface antigen) may be included
* Use of zoliflodacin within 30 days before Day 1
* Use of a moderate or strong inducer or inhibitor of CYP3A4, P-glycoprotein, BCRP, or OATP transporters within 14 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer, before Day 1
* Consumption of grapefruit, grapefruit juice, or similar citrus fruits (like Seville oranges and pomelos) within 14 days before Day 1
* Current use of tobacco or nicotine-containing products
* Known or suspected drug abuse
* A positive drug or alcohol screen result at Screening or on Day -1
* Participants must not donate blood within 30 days or donate plasma within 7 days before Day 1
* Participation in an interventional clinical trial within 30 days or 5 half-lives of the trial drug, whichever is longer, before Day 1
* Any condition or circumstance that, in the investigator's judgment, may pose a risk to the participant or interfere with protocol adherence (including the 72-hour breastfeeding interruption), assessment of trial objectives, or ability to provide informed consent
